SUBJECTS_pit_spikes_half_a_man.title: Pit spikes — half a man tall — game art
SUBJECTS_pit_spikes_half_a_man.lead_html: Your station-45 note: the pit spikes fill the whole cell and should be half as tall as a man and mostly pointed up. A vanilla human draws 1.20 cells tall, so the target is 0.60 cells. v6 (recommended): nine upright stakes in a dirt mound, 0.62 cells tall, standing on the lower part of the cell, same charred timber/rope/iron material. v2: a two-row palisade, 0.51 cells tall, nearly full cell width. v1: a small five-stake fan, 0.35 cells — likely too short. v3/v4 are the raw renders that v5/v6 were shrunk from (0.72 cells, too tall); v5 failed the sprite validator (drifted taller). All keep drawSize 1×1, so only the PNG changes. Shown on plain ground (the sheet tool cannot stage a pit); in game the spikes stand on the pit floor.
